privateHomes.label: Private homes & second-home owners
privateHomes.heroTitle: Smart, secure living for owners near and far
privateHomes.heroSubtitle: Built for Alanya's large community of foreign second-home owners: monitor and control your property from anywhere, in your own language.
painPoints: The property sits empty for months - you need to know it's safe without being there.
Local providers rarely explain systems in your language, so you're never quite sure what you signed up for.
Off-the-shelf DIY kits feel cheap and don't suit a premium villa or apartment.

newBuild.label: New-build villas, residential complexes & developers
newBuild.heroTitle: Security and automation specified at the design stage
newBuild.heroSubtitle: For developers and gated communities: consistent smart-home and security standards across every unit, coordinated with your construction timeline.
painPoints: Retrofitting security after handover is expensive and disrupts finished units.
Buyers increasingly expect smart-home readiness as standard, not an upsell.
Common areas (gates, entrances, shared Wi-Fi) need one coordinated system, not unit-by-unit fixes.
newBuild.cta: Talk to us about your development

hospitality.label: Hotels & tourism businesses
hospitality.heroTitle: Guest safety and smooth operations, without the visible clutter
hospitality.heroSubtitle: Camera coverage, fire safety and guest connectivity designed to protect your rating as much as your property.
painPoints: Guest reviews suffer immediately if Wi-Fi is unreliable or safety feels neglected.
Fire and life-safety compliance is non-negotiable, but systems are often outdated.
Public areas need discreet camera coverage that doesn't make the place feel like a security compound.

retail.label: Retail & grocery markets
retail.heroTitle: Fewer losses, faster checkout, one support number
retail.heroSubtitle: Camera systems, alarms and point-of-sale/barcode systems that work together instead of running on separate contracts.
painPoints: Shrinkage and till discrepancies are hard to investigate without reliable camera footage.
Checkout and stock systems from different vendors rarely talk to each other.
Store Wi-Fi for staff devices and customers is often an afterthought.

gastronomy.label: Restaurants, cafés & bars
gastronomy.heroTitle: Faster service, safer kitchens, calmer dining rooms
gastronomy.heroSubtitle: Adisyon/POS systems, sound and camera coverage tuned for busy service, not generic retail setups.
painPoints: Order and billing (Adisyon) systems that slow staff down during peak service.
Kitchen fire risk needs proper detection, not just a smoke alarm from a hardware store.
Background music needs to cover guest areas evenly, without harsh speakers on show.

commercial.label: Commercial property, offices & parking areas
commercial.heroTitle: One system for access, safety and parking control
commercial.heroSubtitle: Offices, mixed-use buildings and parking areas managed through a single, accountable installer instead of three separate vendors.
painPoints: Access control, fire safety and parking barriers are usually quoted and serviced separately.
Multi-tenant buildings need clear accountability when something needs fixing fast.
Parking areas without barriers or cameras invite disputes and unauthorised use.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Straight answers to the questions we hear most from private owners, developers and businesses in Alanya.

items.a: We install and service systems across Alanya and the wider Antalya province. If you're not sure whether your property is within our service area, message us on WhatsApp with your location.

items.q: Do you work with owners who are not currently in Turkey?
items.a: Yes - a large share of our clients are second-home owners abroad. We can scope a project, agree specifications and schedule installation remotely, in English, Russian or German, ahead of your arrival.

items.q: Can you combine several systems, like cameras, alarm and a smart lock, in one project?
items.a: Yes, this is the most common request. One Hastek team specifies and installs all systems together, so they work as one coordinated setup rather than separate contracts.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance after installation?
items.a: Yes. Scheduled maintenance and rapid-response service are part of our standard offering, particularly important for fire-safety and alarm systems.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Pricing depends on the property and the systems required. Book a free, no-obligation site visit or message our assistant with your segment (home, hotel, retail, etc.) for a first estimate.

items.q: Is my data safe when I submit a booking request?
items.a: Yes. Your details are used only to respond to your enquiry. See our Privacy Policy on the Trust Center page for full details.

answers.greeting: Hello! I'm the Hastek assistant. I can explain our smart-home and security systems, help you find the right setup for your property, or arrange a free site visit. What are you looking to protect or automate?
answers.services: Hastek installs eleven systems across six property types — smart-home automation, smart door locks, video intercom, CCTV cameras, alarms, fire detection, parking barriers, PA/sound, internet & guest Wi-Fi, and POS systems for retail and restaurants. Tell me your property type (home, hotel, shop, restaurant, office) and I'll point you to the right fit — or try the 60-second configurator.
answers.homeSecurity: For homes we usually combine CCTV cameras, an alarm, smart door locks and a video intercom into one app you can check from anywhere — ideal if your place sits empty for part of the year. One team designs, installs and services it all. Want a tailored recommendation? Try the configurator or book a free site visit.
answers.smartHome: Our smart-home automation brings lighting, climate, blinds and scenes into a single app, and ties in neatly with your security systems. You can control and check everything remotely, in your own language. A free site visit lets us tailor it to your property.
answers.business: For hotels, shops, restaurants and commercial sites we cover CCTV, alarms, fire detection, parking barriers, PA/sound, guest Wi-Fi and POS systems (retail barcode or restaurant Adisyon) — coordinated by one accountable team instead of several vendors. Pick your segment on the site, or book a free assessment.
answers.pricing: Pricing depends entirely on the property and the systems you need, so we don't quote fixed prices upfront. The honest way to get an accurate figure is a free, no-obligation site visit — or message us on WhatsApp with a few details for a first estimate. You can also run the configurator to see a recommended setup.
answers.booking: Happy to help you book. Use the 'Book a free site visit' button and tell us your property and preferred timing — a Hastek team member confirms your appointment, usually within one business day. Prefer to talk first? You can reach us on WhatsApp.
answers.whatsapp: WhatsApp is our priority contact channel — a real member of our team replies personally, usually the same business day. Use the WhatsApp button on the site to start a chat. You can also book a free site visit online.
answers.about: HAS Teknoloji (Hastek Group) was founded in Alanya in 2017 by Emre Altuntaş and Harun Çoban, and has installed smart-home and security systems across Alanya and Antalya province ever since. One local team handles design, installation and service — in Turkish, English, Russian and German.
answers.coverage: We're based in Alanya and work across the wider Antalya province. We consult, contract and support in four languages — Turkish, English, Russian and German — which is why many of our clients are international second-home owners. Not sure if your location is covered? Message us on WhatsApp with your address.
answers.maintenance: Maintenance is part of what we do: scheduled servicing and rapid-response support keep systems reliable long after installation — especially important for alarm and fire-safety systems. Each installed device can carry a QR sticker that opens its full service history. Book a visit or message us to arrange servicing.
answers.fallback: I can help with Hastek's smart-home and security systems, finding the right setup for your property, pricing guidance, or booking a free site visit. Could you tell me a bit more — for example your property type (home, hotel, shop, restaurant, office) or the system you're interested in? You can also try the configurator or message us on WhatsApp.

geo.summaryBody: HAS Teknoloji (Hastek Group) is a smart-home and security systems integrator based in Alanya, serving the wider Antalya province since 2017. Founded by Emre Altuntaş and Harun Çoban, the company covers eleven disciplines - from smart-home automation, CCTV and alarm systems to fire detection, parking access and POS - across six property segments. Our team advises and installs in four languages: Turkish, English, Russian and German.
